entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Percent encoding of query string parameters #64730
  • Kestrel throws when specifying `*` IP binding on OS without IPv6 support #64723
  • Blazor Web App Crash in .NET 10 When Auto Component on the Homepage #64722
  • OpenAPI document generation at build time hits error #64721
  • `Content-Encoding: identity` is not a valid value per RFC #64719

Closed

  • Update API remarks for RoutingEndpointConventionBuilderExtensions.RequireHost to warn about host spoofing #48818
    11.0-preview1
  • Conflicting assets with the same target path after upgrading to latest .net version #64726
  • Running a complete Blazor Server host from a nuget package no longer works in .net 10 #64725
  • [WebToolsE2E] After adding Blazor Identity to a Blazor Web App (non-auth, .NET 10.0 project), the User Register failed with an exception:"IdentityRedirectManager can only be used during static rendering." #64572
    .NET 11 Planning
  • .NET 10 OpenAPI IOpenApiSchemaTransformer for SortedList -> List conversion #64694
  • Always set IExceptionHandlerFeature from UseDeveloperExceptionPage #49195
    11.0-preview1
  • Handle Leak of ReadableJsonConfigurationProvider in FromStdInStrategy class #59260
    11.0-preview1
  • OpenAPI: document.Workspace has schemas duplicated #63598
    Backlog
  • OpenApi components schema $ref may not correct #64048
